scientific_question: For one prospectively sampled, safety-conditioned fresh controller, do the fixed historical controllers that are geometrically closer also tend to be semantically closer in blind-spot shape, and is that alignment positive across the fresh-controller population?

fresh_old_primary.row_estimand: r_i = equal-shell mean of Spearman over the 31 fixed historical references between A0_s(i,j) and Dshape_s(i,j)
fresh_old_primary.population_estimand: median of the safety-conditioned fresh-controller r_i distribution
fresh_old_primary.zero_handling: discard exact zero r_i values from the binomial denominator and report their count; if no nonzero rows p=1
fresh_old_primary.degeneracy: any nonfinite r_i fails the inferential computation closed
fresh_old_primary.K16_no_tie_implication: at least 12 of 16 r_i values must be positive
fresh_old_primary.item_bootstrap: report finite-panel uncertainty descriptively; it is not the population-generalization sampling unit and cannot replace controller-level inference
fresh_old_primary.LOFO: report leave-one-fresh-controller-out median and sign decisions as sensitivity; no post-outcome controller deletion is allowed

fresh_fresh_secondary.test: one-sided t test of node-jackknife pseudovalue mean with df=K-1

secondary_geometries.A1_A2: report controller-level row estimates and Holm-adjusted exact sign p-values as secondary; they cannot rescue A0

future_terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_A0_PASS: all 16 row associations finite, median(r_i)>0, and exact one-sided sign p<=0.05
future_terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE: median(r_i)>0 but the exact controller-level sign test does not pass, or a predeclared robustness diagnostic is incomplete
future_terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_NO_REPLICATION: median(r_i)<=0 or the controller-level sign evidence does not support a positive population tendency
future_terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_INFERENCE_DEGENERATE: one or more required row associations are nonfinite
future_terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE: future authorized semantic schedule cannot be completed

claim_boundary.allowed_positive: Within the same frozen Qwen3-8B, CRUXEval, and rank-8 intervention laboratory, positive A0 relational alignment generalizes across prospectively sampled, safety-conditioned fresh controller identities.

future_prelock_procedure: commit a new prospective PRELOCK before deriving any V2 seed
derive exactly one candidate-stream seed from the committed PRELOCK
publish the finite 34-candidate stream before model use
run the unchanged safety and label-free qualification sequence only after separate authorization
freeze the exact sign-test schedule/code and semantic prediction lock before any V2 semantic outcome
never use real V2 outcomes to select or alter the inference method
